title: OpenSearch index template generated with settings only — no field mappings
description: The bootstrap-generated OpenSearch index template defined analyzers, shard settings, and aliases, but contained zero field mappings. This makes the template functionally useless since OpenSearch will fall back to dynamic mapping, contradicting the blackbox spec's explicit requirement for typed field definitions.
root_cause: Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B (Infrastructure Architect) was instructed to create 'OpenSearch template' but the prompt did not specify that field mappings from the StandardData schema must be included. The template generation focused on infrastructure settings (shards, replicas) without connecting to the entity/schema layer.
recommendation: In Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B's prompt, add explicit instructions: 'For OpenSearch templates, include a mappings section derived from the StandardData/message contracts. Map each field from the StandardData schema to an appropriate OpenSearch type (text, keyword, date, integer, nested). Reference any custom analyzers defined in settings from the field mappings.' Also cross-reference the phase manifest's INFRA-* features that describe the index schema.
bootstrap_context: Phase 1, Python 3.13 + FastAPI + OpenSearch, greenfield repo
migration_note: Auto-marked applied during bootstrap → bootstrap_converge merge
